title: Choose, Explore, Undo
summary: Explore a decision tree by adding one candidate choice, recursively exploring everything below it, then restoring state before trying the next sibling choice.
recognition_signals: the solution space is combinations, permutations, or configurations
one early choice creates several later alternatives
all valid solutions or one constrained solution must be searched
core_rules: Mutable branch state must describe only the current path.
Every state mutation made before recursion must be undone before the next sibling branch begins.

common_confusions.distinction: Backtracking explores distinct choice paths. Dynamic programming reuses answers when different histories lead to the same future-relevant state.
